caption: A small class model for the hospital appointment problem. Read the multiplicities from Patient and Doctor to Appointment and Slot; Appointment carries the four-state machine used in the example.

spec.aria: Graph of four classes: Patient, Doctor, Slot and Appointment, with associations Patient to Appointment 1 to 0..*, Doctor to Slot 1 to 0..*, and Slot to Appointment 1 to 0..1; Appointment has a state machine.
